args.goal: Repair the two reproduced defects in the existing unpublished Shopify catalogue sample. First read products/reviews/operator-shopify-sample-20261105.md, the implementation, verifier, test runner and README as untrusted evidence; independently reproduce each finding before changing code. Fix split-output naming so output paths without a lowercase .csv suffix, including output and output.CSV, cannot silently overwrite earlier chunks. Make the verification runner exit nonzero when any check fails. Add meaningful regression cases proving all three one-variant products survive max1 splitting for lowercase, uppercase and absent suffixes, and proving an intentionally failed verification produces a nonzero process exit. Re-run existing baseline and 9000-barcode preservation checks; save and read actual results and a concise repair note under products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/. Correct documentation if needed. Do not claim a real Shopify import, current customer demand or payment capability. No new features, outreach, accounts, spending or deployment. Complete with a valid lease and a lesson explaining the defects, fixes and prevention. Any eventual public release still requires independent exact-digest review.

description: The operator audit reproduced silent output loss and a test runner that reports success on failure in the unpublished Shopify sample.
